verdicts.title: resolveLayersModeLive is a 242-line flag-driven god function
verdicts.note: resolve.go:746-988 is 243 lines with (includeLive, allowCodexCandidate bool); resolveLayersMode (735) and resolveOnMode/resolveOn (691-695) only fix flags. Mis-attached docs confirmed: resolveLayers doc glued on resolveDepth (~708-729) and resolveAliasTarget doc glued on aliasTargetRow (~995-1002). 9 public Resolve* methods in resolve.go plus 2 gate methods in instances.go. Real but a single stable function; medium not high.

verdicts.title: Layer-order replay hand-copied
verdicts.note: Two true copies of the snapshot/overlay/config interleave with layerOrder map: resolve.go:856 and resolve.go:1415 (modelDisabled, whose comment says 'FindModel agrees with Resolve'). canonicalRow (instances.go:259-285) has no layerOrder or extras interleave; it is a simplified variant, not a third copy. FindModel disagreement is a plausible risk but disabled_test.go has FindModel cases.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Write the cross-check test (modelDisabled == Resolve.Model.Disabled over synthetic layer sets incl. missing snapshot/overlay/config tags) first. Then extract a shared extras-interleave helper used by resolveLayersModeLive and modelDisabled only; leave canonicalRow alone unless the test shows drift.

verdicts.title: Credential diagnosis is English prose parsed by prefix
verdicts.note: llm/authenticators.go:92 strings.HasPrefix(w, "no credential") and a case-folded 'credential header %q:' prefix match over res.Warnings; instances.go:982/1005/1036/1041 build the 'no credential (...)' strings. instances_test.go:816 asserts the exact wording. Violates AGENTS.md 'Copy Is Not a Test Oracle'. The ~53 count is unverified (about 76 strings.Contains across registry tests, not all on warnings). New exported type needs Jesse's approval.

verdicts.title: 'Is credential slot usable' decided in four places
verdicts.note: instances.go:1036 (unresolved) and 1041 (empty) arms confirmed plus parallel logic in expandCredentialHeaders, credentialHeaderNames and AuthFingerprint (comments cite mirroring). I did not trace every arm for exact semantic identity; AuthFingerprint 'inert' rules may differ deliberately. Do the pairing with finding 3, with a table test over the slot states first.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Add a table test enumerating slot states against all four consumers; only then extract classifySlot if the tests show identical classification.

verdicts.title: instances.go and resolve.go are grab-bags
verdicts.note: instances.go 1304 lines, resolve.go 1709, AuthFingerprint starts at instances.go:526 and runs to 699 (~173 lines). Pure file moves are safe, but only cosmetic; low.

verdicts.title: Caps/Transport/Provider fields enumerated by hand
verdicts.note: cloneCaps (load.go:573) is hand-written clonePointer per field; mergeCaps is already reflection (merge.go:24). Caps struct has roughly 40 fields by my count, not 47. Real but low-churn; reflection deep copy trades explicitness for magic (Jesse: simplicity over mechanism). A round-trip every-field test alone gives most of the value.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Add the reflection every-field test that fills Caps/Transport and asserts clone/merge preserve all fields. Replace cloneCaps with reflection only if that test shows it is a recurring miss.

verdicts.title: write.go re-implements schema in reverse
verdicts.note: write.go has 28 setString/setBool calls with TOML key literals duplicating schema.go struct tags; confirmed duplication. Claim of exact -130 and the marshal-via-structs plan is unspiked; byte drift in users' providers.toml is the real risk.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: First add an every-field write round-trip test (guards the current writer). Spike struct-tag encoding behind it; abandon if output ordering or empty api_key_env changes.

verdicts.title: Alias-target parsing four times
verdicts.note: load.go:896 aliasTarget (load-time, curated only, accepts alias rows), resolve.go:1003 aliasTargetRow (runtime, recordFor then curated, rejects alias rows), resolve.go:1538-1575 recordMayDisableSeen re-parses inline with glob/target==rec skips. Differences are partly deliberate (load vs runtime; instance vs curated), so a single function needs a mode, not a pure merge. recordMayDisableSeen could call aliasTargetRow, a small win.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Have recordMayDisableSeen call aliasTargetRow; leave load-time aliasTarget separate unless a test shows a dangling alias validating but failing at runtime.

verdicts.title: ResolveGateCredential vs ...Candidate copy-paste
verdicts.note: instances.go:713 and :751 differ only in resolveLayersMode vs resolveLayersModeLive(...,true,true). Sole caller is cmd/evener-hub/spawn.go:885-887 via resolveGateCredentialForSpawn (:884) retrying on ErrCodexModelNotListed. Folding the fallback into one method is safe; add a registry-level test.

verdicts.title: testing.Testing() in production load path
verdicts.note: load.go:18 imports testing; load.go:1234 'case testing.Testing(): offline = o.fetcher == nil'. WithSnapshot/WithOverlay/WithFetcher/WithLog/WaitRefresh have no non-test callers outside registry (refresh.go:189 uses WithSnapshot internally). Production Load callers: cmdutil/registry.go:70, llm/client.go:125, snapshotreport. Flipping default risks network in other packages' tests via cmdutil.LoadRegistry; must verify callers first.

verdicts.title: Dead and test-only exported API
verdicts.note: Confirmed dead: Caps.RequestEffortCapable (derive.go:220-226, only its own definition repo-wide) and getPath (prune.go:233, only prune_test.go:103). Refuted for the rest: AllowedCredentialJSONTypes is used cross-package by llm/providers/tokenauth/gcpadc_fuzz_test.go:40; Baseline is used by llm/providers/* tests and llm/registry_shape_test.go (cross-package test exports cannot be unexported); TemperaturePath/ValidateFields/ParseMeta are package-internal-used and could be unexported harmlessly.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Delete RequestEffortCapable; move getPath into prune_test.go; unexport TemperaturePath, ValidateFields, ParseMeta. Leave Baseline, ThinkingFormats, AllowedCredentialJSONTypes.

verdicts.title: Reinvented state root and atomic write
verdicts.note: State root half confirmed: load.go:204 defaultStateRoot reads only HOME and mirrors cmdutil.StateRootFromLookup (cmdutil/statedir.go:26-60, which handles windows/plan9); defaultConfigRoot (load.go:188) also HOME-only. llm is its own module (llm/go.mod) so it cannot import cmdutil. Atomic write half is overreach: write.go WriteConfigFile deliberately resolves symlinks, sets 0644, and documents the leftover-temp tradeoff; refresh.go:48 writeAtomic is a cache. internal/plugins/atomic.go atomicWriteFile is unexported with test seams. Adding fsync is a behavior change.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Move StateRootFromLookup logic into envvars/userdirs and delete defaultStateRoot/defaultConfigRoot. Skip the shared atomic-write consolidation unless Jesse wants it.

verdicts.title: Model/provider facts hard-coded in Go
verdicts.note: resolve.go:43 vertexGlobalOnly lists 6 Claude patterns plus gemini-3; IsVertexGlobalOnly has one production caller (llm/providers/google/protocol_transport.go:79) plus resolve_test.go. Real but small; the plan adds a new schema key (more mechanism) and needs a Jesse design call. Codex allowlist is product behavior, not a hard-coded fact list.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Defer; raise with Jesse as a design question. Do not add a schema key without approval.

verdicts.title: Overlay Codex rows repeat 13-line block
verdicts.note: providers_overlay.toml ~239-285: gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-sol repeat tools/structured_output/sampling/reasoning/effort_values/input_modalities/responses_lite/thinking_always_on/reasoning_summary and the same body table; image_detail 'omit' on gpt-5.6* vs 'original' on 6.x. A gpt-6* glob would cut it; golden tests guard.

verdicts.title: derive() long function bypassing Caps helpers
verdicts.note: derive.go:36 'reasoningOff := c.Reasoning != nil && !*c.Reasoning' duplicates Caps.ReasoningDisabled (types.go:283) confirmed and trivially fixable. Splitting into four functions is optional taste.

verdicts.title: Comment bloat, history narration, mis-attached docs
verdicts.note: Narration confirmed: instances.go:991 'roborev F2', prune.go:94 'issue #834', prune.go:121 'round-5 probe', write.go:208-221 '#1040 ... Jesse's ruling, 2026-09-07'. Comment-line counts resolve.go 480, instances.go 476 (by '^\s*//'). Mis-attached docs verified (see finding 1).
